note: SNG-238 §5b/§5d (Aevi 2026-07-25): the CONSUMER-REQUIRED-SUBFIELD map - for each content type, which sub-fields a real CONSUMER reads, so CCode's content-shape SWEEP can flag any authored instance missing one (the 'authored-but-under-shaped' class: string-stages=variant1, title-less stages=variant2). Verified at origin by grepping the render/engine code for X.subfield reads on authored collections - NON-speculative, each field cites its consumer + file:line. Severity: CRASH (consumer throws/NaN), EMPTY (renders blank/dead control), DEGRADED (works but hollow - e.g. no image). The sweep asserts presence+type; a field a consumer READS is a field the author AND the generator (SNG-234/§5c) must SUPPLY. Grows by incident. Aevi owns this list (what-each-consumer-reads is content/PO knowledge); CCode builds the sweep against it.

howTheSweepUsesThis: For each contentType, for each authored instance, assert every non-optional field here is PRESENT and (where typed) correctly TYPED. CRASH-severity missing = the build must fail (a consumer throws). EMPTY = fail (renders broken - the visible class). DEGRADED = warn (works but hollow - e.g. no image) unless Erik promotes it. The generator round-trip (§5c) runs its OUTPUT through this same map. Grows by incident: a new consumer.read that breaks on absence adds a line here + the sweep covers it.
provenance: Every field verified at origin by grepping the consumer code for X.subfield reads (2026-07-25): quest reads app.js~6070-6130/7291; npc reads gm.js (25x .name) + SNG-233 directive; location reads random_encounters.js/SNG-180; creature reads random_encounters.js. Non-speculative - if a field isn't read by a real consumer, it's NOT here (no bloat, the SNG-232 lesson).
